test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which state has the highest length (in km) of national highways as per the data of 2017?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra leads states in terms of the construction of national highways**.
 
• In 2017-18, it built** 1,345 km,** followed by **Rajasthan and Karnataka**.
 
• The state also holds the** distinction of having the highest NH network**, spanning **17,749 km** and **racing ahead of Uttar Pradesh** with **11,476 km** in the network.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Highways** are classified into **three categories **based on the type of Lane i.e.** Less than Two Lane**, **Two Lane** and **Four-Lane & above**.
 
• The **longest National Highway** is **NH44**__, which runs between **Srinagar in Jammu and Kashmir and Kanyakumari in Tamil Nadu**, covering a distance of** 3,806 km.**
 
• **"Bharatmala” Pariyojana** is an umbrella programme for the highway sector that **focuses on optimising the efficiency** of **freight and passenger **movements across the country.
 
• The** Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)** is mandated with the** construction, development and maintenance** of the National Highways (NH) in the country.
